basis: 2026 foundation, revised for 2027; Year 11 teaching-from-2026 and Year 12 teaching-from-2027 unit content

categories.required: Required syllabus knowledge or skill: use the item-level provision review for the exact source and practice.
categories.support-booklet: Official support-booklet convention or example. Teach it in its relevant sequence; do not dismiss it as optional enrichment merely because a keyword is not a separate unit bullet.
categories.implementation: A tool, model or context used to practise required concepts. Its particular software, equipment or syntax is not itself a new syllabus requirement.
categories.enrichment: Additional content beyond the explicit unit-content list; teach and practise it before including it in a locally issued task.

notes: Optional revisit means return after prerequisites; it does not mean that the underlying syllabus skill is optional.
School-issued task scope and the official support booklet determine required preparation; this register is editorial guidance, not an assurance that a topic cannot be assessed.

Specialist drone, VR and network-pod pathways are companion contexts. The general textbook and ordinary-computer/paper preparation remain available. Actual software/network-tool execution needs an appropriate authorised environment.

entries.title: HAVING after GROUP BY
entries.note: HAVING is shown in the official support booklet (printed p22). It filters completed groups; learn it after core GROUP BY and aggregate practice. It is support-booklet SQL, rather than a separately named unit-content bullet or an optional-only topic.

entries.title: LEFT JOIN for unmatched records
entries.note: LEFT JOIN syntax is additional to the explicitly listed INNER JOIN work. It supports this all-session report. Counting real keys and distinguishing NULL from recorded absence remain important reasoning; do not replace required multiple-table INNER JOIN practice with this extension.

entries.title: Composite keys and missing attendance
entries.section: Respect composite keys and unknown attendance
entries.note: Correct composite references and interpretation of data are required concepts. The LEFT JOIN implementation used here is a supporting extension; both key columns must still match.

entries.title: ACID concepts and explicit SQLite transaction commands
entries.section: Use transactions to protect a booking
entries.note: ACID is required Year 12 knowledge. BEGIN, COMMIT and ROLLBACK illustrate an implementation in the chosen SQLite tool; they are not a separate additional prescribed keyword list. Teach tool behaviour before requiring it locally.

entries.title: Pygame, drone, VR and network-pod contexts
entries.note: These are delivery choices for practising required programming, data and networking skills. A graphical user interface and specialist hardware are not general textbook prerequisites. The companion pathway retains local assessment contexts.

entries.title: CPU pipeline and buffer model
entries.note: The activity supplies supporting computer-systems context and a constant-rate arithmetic model. It does not add a CPU architecture examination requirement to the mapped unit items.

entries.title: Subnet planning: Year 12 progression
entries.note: The Year 12 address-planning skill is required. Its detailed subnet allocation can be a later bridge for Year 11 learners; a Year 11 extension label must not be read as excluding it from Year 12.

entries.title: Cisco network-diagram conventions
entries.note: Use the official symbol table (printed p12) when constructing required logical diagrams. Label roles, LAN/WLAN/WAN boundaries, links and the trust perimeter; check symbols against that reference. Generic role boxes alone are not a symbol-convention demonstration.

entries.title: ODBC knowledge versus an installed driver lab
entries.note: The application/driver/data-source/result path is required knowledge. The explanation and independent comparison do not require an installed ODBC driver. A direct sqlite3 example is not described as an ODBC connection.
